# CaptionMeta

Android photo metadata editor, listed on Google Play as Photo Metadata & IPTC Editor by AndroidManTou.

Edit supported photo captions, keywords, credits and copyright. Reuse presets, inspect metadata cleanup, and deliver processed photos to a user-configured server. Format support varies. Metadata cleanup does not guarantee anonymity.

## First-party pages
- https://iptc.pages.dev/
- https://iptc.pages.dev/en-US/
- https://iptc.pages.dev/blog/en-US/
- https://iptc.pages.dev/en-US/support
